definitions.explanation: Political positions or groups that advocate for social equality, progressive reform, or socialism. Can refer to individuals, parties, or ideological positions.
The left side of a formation — the left field position in baseball, or the left flank in military formations.

notes:
Literally 'left wing' (⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧ + ⟦{翼|つばさ}→翼：03528_tsubasa⟧ 'wing'). The political sense originates from the French Revolution, where supporters of change sat on the left side of the assembly. In Japanese, the political sense is the most common usage, but the baseball sense is also frequently encountered.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {左翼|さよく}⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧: left-wing political party
- {左翼的|さよくてき}: left-leaning, leftist
- {左翼|さよく}⟦{思想|しそう}→思想：03173_shisou⟧: left-wing ideology
- ⟦{左翼手|さよくしゅ}→左翼手：29930_sayokushu⟧: left fielder (baseball)
- ⟦{極左|きょくさ}→極左：23933_kyokusa⟧: far left, extreme left

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{右翼|うよく}→右翼：12071_uyoku⟧: right wing — the opposite term, both in politics and positionally
- ⟦{革新|かくしん}→革新：05617_kakushin⟧: progressive, reformist — a softer term for left-leaning politics
- レフト: left (field) — the baseball loanword, more casual than {左翼|さよく}
